critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~5050 lines — extracting /compliance and /injury-reserve-compliance-mode into a dedicated router is recommended for maintainability.

GET /api/teams/{team_id}/compliance uses bare ObjectId(team_id) without try/except — a malformed team_id string returns 500 instead of 400. Consider wrapping in try/except for defensive input validation.
Compliance endpoint has no auth guard — any authenticated user (or even anonymous) can fetch any team's compliance status. Consider restricting to team owner / commissioner / league members.
PUT /injury-reserve-compliance-mode uses a raw dict payload instead of a Pydantic model. Recommend typed model (class IRComplianceModeUpdate) for consistent validation and better OpenAPI docs.
CommissionerSettings.tsx is 3028 lines — splitting by tab would improve maintainability and test isolation.
